# Nonplayer Character

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Terminology](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#NonplayerCharacter)*

A nonplayer character (NPC) is a monster that has a personal name and a distinct personality. *See also* "[Monster](Monster.md)."
